title.value: User-Centered Design for Promoting Patient Engagement in Chronic Diseases Management: The Development of CONCERTO+
title.justification: The title is explicitly mentioned in the paper's heading, outlining the focus on patient engagement in chronic disease management through the development of CONCERTO+.
title.quote: User-Centered Design for Promoting Patient Engagement in Chronic Diseases Management: The Development of CONCERTO+

analysis.description: This research paper discusses the development of CONCERTO+, a patient portal designed to enhance patient engagement in chronic disease management through a user-centered design process. The paper details the iterative design phases, usability tests, and the collaborative approach taken to refine and implement the solution.

type.justification: The paper describes the empirical processes involved in designing and testing the CONCERTO+ portal through usability tests and involving real users (patients and caregivers).
type.quote: The solution was developed through 3 phases, based on user-centered design methods [3], and usability was assessed with patients.

name.justification: The primary focus of the paper is on developing a digital health solution (CONCERTO+) aimed at chronic disease management, which fits within the domain of eHealth technologies.
name.quote: eHealth technologies have the potential to support chronic disease management by considering end-users’ needs, preferences, and capabilities.

name.justification: The paper focuses on how eHealth technologies can aid in managing chronic diseases through improved patient engagement.
name.quote: Multimorbidity increases care needs among people with chronic diseases. In order to support communication between patients, their informal caregivers and their healthcare teams, we developed CONCERTO+, a patient portal for chronic disease management in primary care.

name.justification: A significant part of the paper discusses the user-centered design approach used to develop CONCERTO+.
name.quote: The development of CONCERTO+ was done through a collaborative approach... based on user-centered design methods [3]...
